title: Fan-in of the DNF circuit
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every Boolean function $f\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$, the circuit obtained by the specified DNF construction is well formed: each gate reads distinct vertices, and every negation gate has exactly one input. Every gate in the circuit has at most two inputs.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on $n$ Boolean inputs
